_comment: The kid-facing allow-list for tools/export_player_data.py. Canon (rpg_kids) says WHAT exists. This file says what ships to the tablets and how it reads for a 5 and a 7 year old. Keys must match canon names exactly (trailing parentheticals stripped). Anything in canon with no entry here fails the export on purpose. That is the secrets filter.

party.name: The Lima Sisters
party.goldUnknownNote: Your gold and gems are real! Count them in your own pouch.

The Moon-Stone.text: The lost heart of the old kingdom. It is shaped like the moon on our family crest. We found it deep under our town!

The Ancient Field Log.text: An old explorer's notebook full of clues.

The Wayfinder Prism.text: A crystal that turns light into rainbows.

Pouch of Star-Seeds.text: Tiny seeds that glow like stars. 2 uses left.

Mom's letter.name: Mom's Letter
Mom's letter.text: Sealed with purple wax. It is from Mom!

Torn letter from Odbert's box.name: The Torn Letter
Torn letter from Odbert's box.text: From Odbert's box. Part of it is missing.

Iridescent shield-boss stone.name: The Shield-Boss Stone
Iridescent shield-boss stone.text: A shimmering stone. It fits the picture on the cavern wall.

Silver brooch.name: The Silver Brooch
Silver brooch.text: We found it in the old ruins under the town. Nobody knows what it is for yet.

The Æthelia music box.name: The Old Music Box
The Æthelia music box.text: It played music in the ruins for a very, very long time. When we picked it up, it stopped. It was waiting for its owners to come home!

heroes.tagline: An elf healer. Her staff glows with rainbow light.

Searing Light.text: Shoot a beam of light at a monster up to 4 squares away.

Healing Touch.text: Remove 1 damage from yourself or a friend next to you.

Potion Brewer.text: After a battle, refill 1 potion that you or a friend used.

Crescent Moon Shield.text: You and friends next to you get 1 extra armor die for 2 turns.
Crescent Moon Shield.limit: After you cast it, the moon must rest for 3 turns.

Ring of Sisters Lima.text: Worn on her hand. It glows when the sisters are together.

the Rainbow Book of Everyone.name: The Rainbow Book of Everyone
the Rainbow Book of Everyone.text: Ask your book one question about someone you can see. It writes one true answer in rainbow ink. It answers only one question about each thing, ever. Write a new friend in your book, and talking to them gets 1 extra die.

pet: Rainbow Fairy (the hearth fairy).name: Rainbow Fairy
pet: Rainbow Fairy (the hearth fairy).text: A hearth fairy who chose you. She throws sparkly dust in a monster's eyes. Then it attacks with 1 less die.

heroes.tagline: Strong and brave. She hits hard and protects her sisters.

Cloud-Cutter Strike.text: Swing your blade at a monster right next to you.

Knockback Attack.text: Attack with 1 less die. If you hit, push the monster back 4 squares.

Retaliation.text: If a monster hurt you and you hit it back, deal 2 damage.

Meteor Strike.text: Leap high and smash the ground. Monsters within 2 squares must dodge or take 1 damage.
Meteor Strike.limit: You cannot use it two turns in a row.

Ring of Sisters Lima.text: Worn on her hand. It glows when the sisters are together.

the Sun-Jewel.name: The Sun-Jewel
the Sun-Jewel.text: A golden gem you found at the bottom of a pool. It drinks up daylight and shines in the dark. It is the key that opened the old door.

the Sky-Saver Shout.name: The Sky-Saver Shout
the Sky-Saver Shout.text: Once a battle, shout out loud and tell a monster why it should stop. Roll 2 dice. A 5 or a 6 means it stops fighting! If not, it gets so rattled that it comes at you and rolls 1 less die.

pet: Constellation Kitten (\"Starry\"),.name: Starry
pet: Constellation Kitten (\"Starry\"),.text: A kitten with stars in her fur. Her stars light up when something is hidden nearby. Then you get 1 extra die to look for it.

excludedHeroes.Fire in Disguise: Guest hero played by Mom. Not one of the sisters. Stays out of the app.
excludedHeroes.Night Armor: Removed 2026-09-15 per the GM: the girls do not know about her yet. She is an unintroduced NPC, not a sister, even though master_lore.md and house_rules.md still list her as a hero. Put her back only when she appears at the table.

The waking queen.name: Queen Stars
The waking queen.text: Deep under our town, a queen made of stone opened her eyes. We named her Queen Stars. We asked her lots and lots of questions.

The Moon waits for the Sun.name: The Moon Waits for the Sun
The Moon waits for the Sun.text: Our family crest has a moon and a sun. We found the moon part. Where is the sun part? Queen Stars has not told us yet.

Find mother.name: Seek the Forgotten Strongholds
Find mother.text: Mom said do not follow her. Find the old strongholds of our people instead.

The Sealed Path.reason: Never played. Per the GM (2026-09-15) the girls have not met Silas or seen his map. Canon current_state.md and rivenshore.md wrongly mark it revealed, and it points at the Sun-half arc.

Ameelea & Bree.name: Tell Bree the Good News
Ameelea & Bree.text: We forgave Ameelea for being a bully. Now we have to tell Bree that she is invited to Ameelea's fort.

Bree.name: Keep Bree Safe
Bree.text: Bree is hiding at Moira's. She owes us a favor.

_peopleComment: One entry per bullet in canon current_state.md 'NPC Relationships', keyed by the bullet's first bold name. The value is one card, a list of cards (one bullet can name two people), or {"hidden": true, "reason": ...}. Pictures under Reference_Anchors/ are named from the asset pipeline root. artName renames the shipped file. Look at every picture before naming it.

Odbert.name: Odbert
Odbert.text: He runs the Block and Tackle, a cozy tavern and shop. Mom left a secret box with him to keep safe. We saved Roger there two times, so Odbert treats us like royalty!

Moira.name: Moira
Moira.text: A sweet gnome who makes magic potions. Behind her shop is a safe, hidden home for kids whose magic woke up too soon. She gave us our first spells and told us about the Moon-Stone.

Bree.name: Bree
Bree.text: A girl our age with magic fire. Some bullies made her so sad that flames burst out. We helped her calm down. Now she hides safe at Moira's, and she owes us a favor.

The Sheriff.name: The Sheriff
The Sheriff.text: He keeps our town safe. He is stern but fair. He paid us gold and gems for helping fix the town after the fire.

Elara.name: Elara
Elara.text: She runs the Hearth and Honey Bakery. She thinks every hero is far too skinny!

Old man Grimma.name: Old Man Grimma
Old man Grimma.text: He runs the Shattered Potion shop. We chased looters away from it. He is extra fond of Rainbow because she heals people. His special potion is called Hypulation!

Bill & AJ.name: Bill and AJ
Bill & AJ.text: Bill is the miller, and AJ is his wife. We met them while fixing up the town, and we gave their mill its name. It is WaterPour Mill!

Old Fishy.name: Old Fishy
Old Fishy.text: The oldest sailor in town. He says he once caught a giant rainbow jellyfish with a narwhal horn. Do you believe him?

Ella.name: Ella
Ella.text: She is the boss of the kids who run errands in the Market Square. The butcher pays them the best!

Ameelea.name: Ameelea
Ameelea.text: She was one of the kids who bullied Bree. She felt truly sorry, so we forgave her. Now Bree is invited to her fort.

Pippa.name: Pippa
Pippa.text: She works at the Archives. She talks super fast and her papers go everywhere. We sorted her filing, and she let us go down to the old vault.

Perriglossa.name: Perriglossa
Perriglossa.text: A knight who guarded the old ruins for a very, very long time. Dark magic had hold of her until our last hit knocked it out. Now she comes with us.

Suzie.name: Suzie
Suzie.text: A knight of the old ruins. She loves us, and she cannot stop hiccuping and burping!

Suzie.name: Lima Protector
Suzie.text: A knight of the old ruins. She only ever says one thing: "My name is Lima Protector, long ago I made an oath to protect the Limas, that is why my name is Lima Protector."

Queen Stars, the queen in the stone.name: Queen Stars
Queen Stars, the queen in the stone.text: A queen made of stone. She opened her eyes when we lifted the Moon-Stone, and we named her Queen Stars. She said Rainbow's staff reminds her of the magic tools of long ago. Everything else, she says, will come later.

pets.text: Your pet found you! Look for your friend under My Things on your hero page.
